We need to find a retrosynthetic template that when applied to the given molecule (initial_molecule SMILES: COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O) reproduces the Diels-Alder reaction (forward). We need to return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction. So we need to search template catalog for Diels-Alder type (bonds broken: C=C to C-C etc). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken maybe "alkene"? Actually Diels-Alder breaks two C=C bonds (in diene and dienophile) and forms two C-C bonds. So functional_groups_broken: ["alkene"]? functional_groups_formed: none? But we need forward reaction: bonds broken: "C=C" (maybe bond type 6-6?). Not sure.

We can try search with bonds_broken ["6-6"] and bonds_formed ["6-6"]? But need two bonds broken and formed. Use bonds_broken ["6-6","6-6"]? The tool expects list of strings like "6-6". We'll just provide one.

Let's try search_template_catalog_by_criteria with molecule SMILES and bonds_broken ["6-6"], bonds_formed ["6-6"].
